levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» takes over the whole chain of report 2 (prev1), which writes it, so the seven names are inherited and the back reference is not written.
«وما رأيت محمديا قط يعدله» is a remark, not a name, and is left out.
«قال رسول الله» is the Prophet, the end of the chain.
